text:
Type: nesting coffee tables, set of two
Use: holding drinks and books in front of a sofa; living room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, retro
Materials: fir wood, herringbone pattern top, solid wood legs
Colors: light warm natural wood, soft brown
Shape: oblong teardrop tops, three round splayed tapered legs each, smaller table slides under the larger, low and light
Feel: playful, warm, airy
Goes with: light wood, white walls, linen and wool textiles; mid-century or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Oblong End/Side/Nesting Tables, Firwood
product.description: Global-inspired wood grain patterns give these nesting tables an eye-catching finish, while the oblong shape and angled legs are mid-century inspired. This handsome pair can hold snack trays and remote controls, or stack together to save room. Large: 46.87x23.25x22; Small 31.5x15.75x19.25 Engineered wood and fiberboard Mid-century with globally-inspired touches Can nestle together to accommodate small spaces Simple assembly in 30 minutes or less; just screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
